deviations_from_card: Revision applied: no dialog; on Err the shell prints `shadowrunr console: daemon endpoint from <source> is refused (<rule>): ...` to stderr and exits 1; no Cargo.toml change. Coupled files outside write_set: apps/console/src/data/rpc.ts (DEFAULT_DAEMON_URL moved to config.ts so errors.ts can import config without an import-x/no-cycle error), apps/console/src/kit/QueryView.tsx and apps/console/src/pages/brain/Runs.tsx (OfflineState now takes a required `hint` prop because ui may not import data), apps/console/src/ui/ui.test.tsx (OfflineState case), apps/console/budgets/bundle.json (entry js 296,500 -> 297,000, measured 296,211 -> 296,595 B, under the lock, own commit 569f4bb). Shell: loopback hosts 127.0.0.1/localhost/[::1], http only, origin only (no path/query/userinfo), port 1-65535; empty SHADOWRUNR_DAEMON_URL is treated as absent. The window is created in setup (tauri.conf.json main window create:false) with an initialization script defining a read-only window.__SHADOWRUNR_DAEMON__.
notes: Rust cases (4) were red before by non-existence (no endpoint module); tests and implementation committed together in 55ee410 since they cannot compile apart. Console: 4 red before, 1 guard green. `pnpm -C apps/console build` rc=1 ONLY on characters.l2 js 121,359 > 118,000 and css 30,489 > 29,800: the characters-page B sibling's uncommitted work in apps/console/src/pages/characters; entry is within its raised budget. Earlier typecheck/test reds in pages/onair/view.test.ts (stage-kit-overlays sibling) cleared on re-run. cargo used --offline; no toolchain/network. The desktop shell was not launched (no GUI run); CSP injection relies on tauri 2.12.4 manager.csp() reading config at runtime (verified in the crate source).
